Episode 209. The Seventh Tomb of Temar - Kaytam's Painting (2)
As soon as the two people approached the circle and put their heads in as Kaytam had said, they felt as if the ground was collapsing.
After blinking once, a dense bush was revealed. It must have been somewhere in the Murakan range a thousand years ago.
"Huh, that guy's ability is really interesting. Is this really inside the painting? The smell of soil from all around and the wind blowing, everything feels so real."
Murakan said, looking around.
"This tomb is different from the places we've experienced before. We're not just glimpsing the past, but can directly exercise physical force."
Jin said, sitting down and gently brushing a blade of grass. The blade of grass moved back and forth following Jin's touch.
The circle that the two people had entered was not visible anywhere.
"I can't see the circle. There's an entrance but no exit."
"Are you worried? That you might not be able to get out?"
"No, after all this is a subspace, so if worse comes to worst I can tear it open with the spirit sword."
He had not tried it. This was because touching this already damaged subspace could cause problems.

"Well, that's true, but with this Murakan, we will feel safe. Frankly, now that the kid and I are traveling together, it will not be easy to feel danger anywhere. Even if the Elona Zephyr comes, we won't be afraid."

That was true. The combination of Jin and Murakan was now able to solve most variables with force, even if they moved without much strategy. That's why they entered the painting without much hesitation.
"That's true."
"Haha! It's been a long time since I felt this way! Yes, if this is the residence of this Murakan, it should be like this. It should be this majestic!"
Jin was glad to see that Murakan was in a good mood.

Whenever Murakan remembered events from a thousand years ago, he would either feel a headache or appear to lose his sanity. This had happened when he first met Orgal in the old Oterium during his prospective knight days, and when he saw the old sword of Hedo (now used by Bale) in the Sota Desert.

'I had to hit Murakan to snap him back to his senses each time, but fortunately this time he got better quickly. Is it because he's gotten stronger, or is the memory that's come back this time not as shocking?'
-[It was me who stopped your friend Temar from killing you when you went berserk, Murakan. Don't you remember me?]

- Who does this bastard dare to sell the name of so casually. He seems like a devil who has lived long enough, but it's not possible that Temar associated with such a creature. Besides, a rampage? It seems like you have heard something from somewhere. That day's rampage...

-[Are you trying to say it was not you, but Temar who rampaged that day? That you don't recognize me is one thing, but remembering that day's battle as Temar's responsibility... You can't even imagine how unfair your dead friend would feel if he knew this.]
Jin recalled the conversation between Orgal and Murakan in the old Oterium.
'If the truth about the fight between Temar and Murakan is left here... and if what Orgal said that day is true. Can this guy handle it?'
Rather than the unidentified guardians that Kaytam had depicted in the subspace, Jin was more worried about this.
"Kid, what are you thinking about? That's not a look of awe after seeing my abode."
"I was just wondering what to do if I have to hit you again. Like if you lose your senses when confronting the past."
"Humph, are you saying this because I just felt a headache?"
"It would be unbearable if you go on a rampage."
"There's no need to worry, kid. Let's see, at a quick glance, it seems like this is part of the mountain range extending to the southernmost part of Mitel."
"You recognized that it's just in the middle of a mountain?"

"Why wouldn't I know my own home? I recognized it as soon as I saw part of the mountain range from the outside of the painting. Especially this was an area I liked. Many stupid dragons thought it wasn't my area and passed without thinking. It was satisfying to beat them. I miss it, I really do."

For a while, Murakan excitedly talked about the memories of those days that came to mind. They were mostly stories of the time he spent in the mountain range, but it seemed that there was no recollection of the most important, Runcandel.
"Do you like it that much?"
"Yes. But I like the present time with you and Strawberry Pie more. I don't want to go back because I can't forget this time, so don't be upset, my contractor."
"Wow, I'm so grateful I don't know what to do with myself. But now I don't know where to go. Does Temar's tomb really exist separately?"

"Didn't Lord Kaytam say he captured the events of a thousand years ago? I think this whole space is a tomb. It seems like he has captured the entire kingdom of Mitel from a thousand years ago. Let's head towards the border since we're at the southernmost part. We're checking if the beyond the border is also depicted."
[Meow!]
Shuri came out of the Red Jade. As they ran down the mountain, they immediately came across the border with a heterogeneous landscape.
There was only a border, and beyond it was a blank white background. Kaytam didn't paint anything there. There was no sign of the border patrol that should have been guarding it.
"That's right, there's nothing."
"The place we have to go is obvious, kid. It's the Storm Castle. Is there any other place?"
"Then all the guardians must be gathered there."
"I wonder who the guardians might be. Since Master Keitam drew the Mitel Kingdom, I suppose they might be the Ten Knights."
"Let's fly there quickly."
"Can't we take it slow on Shuri and look around a bit? A black dragon like me sometimes wants to indulge in memories. You, a kid, wouldn't understand."
"Yes, yes. Let's take a look around then."

Even though time was of the essence, he couldn't refuse as Murakan seemed to enjoy the scenery. If Jin someday had the opportunity to reflect on his youthful memories, he wouldn't just pass it by. Of course, Murakan wasn't that old by dragon standards.
[Meow, meow, meow.]
Shuri began to briskly traverse the mountain ridge. Occasionally, wild animals watched them curiously.
After a while, Shuri was already leaping over the mountain peaks, and when they reached a lower peak, they could see cities and towns below.
But still.

It was impossible to identify which part of the drawing had been damaged. The mountain range was full of fresh memories, and there was no sign of any polluted scenery. The weather was so clear and cool that Jin's mood improved accordingly.
"Let's go down to that village. The humans might remember me."
"Let's do that. But won't they be scared if you suddenly appear? You said they used to get scared when they saw you in this period."
This time, Murakan transformed and carried Jin and Shuri on his back. They descended quickly and reached the village in an instant.

[Dragons, demons, or strong humans with bad attitudes were scared. Ordinary humans of the Mitel Kingdom who had seen me personally didn't react that way. They welcomed and worshipped me. I occasionally helped humans deal with their problems. I hunted down monster cubs, dug wells, and hit aggressive bureaucrats. They all liked me so much.]
"You were like that?"
[Did you think I was always fighting and killing? To the creatures, I'm the generous black dragon, Murakan.]

Looking back, it seemed plausible. Murakan often scared "bad-attitude" humans, dragons, or demons (like when he first met Kashimir), but he often showed kindness towards ordinary and weak people. He also played well with children.
In other words, the only ones that Murakan picked fights with or threatened without reason were those who were enemies or warriors by his standards.
[Hahaha, humans! Here I am!]
Although it was a painting and not real, Murakan yelled as if he was interacting with real villagers from that period.
And the people who were strolling in the street, as soon as they saw Murakan, they became pale and screamed.
"Ah!"
"Everyone, run...!"
"Run? How can we run? Haven't you heard the stories? One breath from him can make a whole neighborhood disappear!"
At that sight, Murakan froze in mid-air, about to descend to the ground. His large pumpkin-colored eyes blinked incessantly.
"Damn, this monster bastard. Why does he keep doing this for no reason? Is he going to play with us like bugs like he did with the people of Loron and then kill us?"
Loron was the name of another nearby city.
"Shut up! Lord Murakan, I apologize. This friend of mine seems to be crazy. Please, I beg you, spare the children at least... I beg you like this."
The village quickly turned into a chaotic mess. The people who gathered in front of Murakan were begging, cursing, and screaming each in their own way.
Their cries were so vivid that it was impossible to think of them as just a picture.
"[...What? What's this about? Are you confusing me with someone else right now? When did I kill you?]"
"You slaughtered Loron just two days ago! Are you saying you've already forgotten? Do you not even remember because you commit massacres every day?"
"Shut up! Why do you keep provoking Lord Murakan? Shouldn't we at least save the children...?"
"Ha, has he ever spared the children even when you beg like that? That guy is pure evil. He's an existence that should not exist in this world."
Jin could feel Murakan's heart beating wildly beneath his scales. He also noticed that the energy Murakan was carrying was becoming unstable. It was a sign of a rampage.
Shuri licked Murakan's back, seeming worried.
"[I never did such a thing... I have no memory of ever killing powerless humans for no reason...]."
"What's with that reaction? Are you suddenly feeling guilty? Just because you can't remember doesn't mean it didn't happen."
The young man, who had been continuously cursing at Murakan, spoke in a calm voice. Jin was considering whether he should hit Murakan.
But fortunately.
Soon, Murakan showed signs of regaining his senses by controlling his tangled energy. He let out a deep sigh as he came to terms with the shock.

"[It seems like there's some misunderstanding. First, I have no intention of harming you. And whether you believe it or not, the things you just mentioned are not my doing. So let's talk in detail. It seems there is another me here, and I'll definitely find him and take revenge for you.]"
"Really, sir!?"
"[Yes! I have no history of saying two different things. And what was Runcondel doing while that bastard impersonating me was causing this mess? What are Temar and the Knights of the Decade doing?]"
At the mention of Temar's name, the people's eyes widened.
"...Sir Temar is in retreat after receiving a fatal injury from Lord Murakan. Do you really not remember, or are you playing with us? If not, are you really a different Lord Murakan?"
